title: Seasons
label: ch:hi-seasons
canDo: I can name all six traditional Indian seasons in Hindi, including the one the four-season frame has no word for.

payoff.summary: Complete HI-C14-checkpoint, the chapter's closing checkpoint: say all six ऋतु in order and point to वर्षा, recall ghī, say what ◌ँ does and what घ carries, tell ऋ from र, then write ऋ, घ and ◌ँ from memory.
payoff.note: HI-C14-checkpoint (sequence 614, HI-PATH-017 order 1, after HI-S125-letter-vocalic-r and before chapter 15's first lesson) assesses all seven atoms the chapter introduces (7/7). The chapter's sequence and its path disagreed: HI-C14-ritu (610) is before the candrabindu, घ and ऋ lessons by sequence (611-613) but after all of them on the path, since HI-S118 and HI-S136 sit in HI-PATH-100 and HI-S125 in HI-PATH-016. So ऋतु could not assess them, and HI-S125 could not take ऋतु's season atoms. The checkpoint comes after all of them on both orders; HI-C14-ritu stays as the chapter's spoken lesson (3/7 on its own).
